titulo_es: Interrupt, retake and give up the word

texto: Interrupt with courtesy, take the turn and check that it has been understood. **Jag vill lägga till något** means «Can I add one thing?». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 1 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
